targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Network Devices" FROM inventory.network_device_operational_overview WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR site_key='${site:raw}') AND ('${device_type:raw}'='All' OR device_type='${device_type:raw}')

SELECT count(*) AS "Interfaces" FROM inventory.network_interfaces ni JOIN inventory.network_device_operational_overview nd ON nd.device_key=(SELECT device_key FROM inventory.network_devices WHERE id=ni.network_device_id) WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR nd.site_key='${site:raw}') AND ('${device_type:raw}'='All' OR nd.device_type='${device_type:raw}')

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE nl.status<>'up') AS "Links at Risk" FROM inventory.network_links nl JOIN inventory.network_devices nd ON nd.id=nl.source_device_id LEFT JOIN inventory.racks r ON r.id=nd.rack_id LEFT JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.id=r.row_id LEFT JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.id=dr.room_id LEFT JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=rm.site_id WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR s.site_key='${site:raw}')
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE nc.status<>'up') AS "WAN at Risk" FROM inventory.network_circuits nc JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=nc.site_id WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR s.site_key='${site:raw}')

links.title: Open VLAN and IP capacity details

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "VLANs" FROM inventory.network_vlans nv JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=nv.site_id WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR s.site_key='${site:raw}')
SELECT round(avg(utilization_pct),1) AS "WAN Utilization" FROM inventory.network_circuits nc JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=nc.site_id WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR s.site_key='${site:raw}')

SELECT sum(open_alerts) AS "Open Network Alerts" FROM inventory.network_device_operational_overview WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR site_key='${site:raw}') AND ('${device_type:raw}'='All' OR device_type='${device_type:raw}')

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE nv.status<>'active') AS "Routing Domains at Risk" FROM inventory.network_vrfs nv JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=nv.site_id WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR s.site_key='${site:raw}')
SELECT count(*) AS "L2 Switches" FROM inventory.network_device_operational_overview WHERE device_type='switch' AND role ILIKE '%access%' AND ('${site:raw}'='All' OR site_key='${site:raw}')
SELECT count(*) AS "L3 Switches" FROM inventory.network_device_operational_overview WHERE device_type='switch' AND role ILIKE '%core%' AND ('${site:raw}'='All' OR site_key='${site:raw}')
SELECT count(*) AS "Firewalls" FROM inventory.network_device_operational_overview WHERE device_type='firewall' AND ('${site:raw}'='All' OR site_key='${site:raw}')
SELECT count(*) AS "VLANs" FROM inventory.network_vlans nv JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=nv.site_id WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR s.site_key='${site:raw}')
SELECT count(*) AS "VRFs" FROM inventory.network_vrfs nv JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=nv.site_id WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR s.site_key='${site:raw}')

SELECT s.name AS "Data Center", sd.hostname||' · '||nl.source_interface AS "Source", td.hostname||' · '||nl.target_interface AS "Target", initcap(replace(nl.link_type,'_',' ')) AS "Link Type", round(nl.bandwidth_bps/1000000000.0,0)||' Gbps' AS "Capacity", nl.utilization_pct AS "Utilization %", nl.latency_ms AS "Latency ms", nl.packet_loss_pct AS "Loss %", initcap(nl.status) AS "Status", nl.redundancy_group AS "Redundancy Group" FROM inventory.network_links nl JOIN inventory.network_devices sd ON sd.id=nl.source_device_id JOIN inventory.network_devices td ON td.id=nl.target_device_id LEFT JOIN inventory.racks r ON r.id=sd.rack_id LEFT JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.id=r.row_id LEFT JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.id=dr.room_id LEFT JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=rm.site_id WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR s.site_key='${site:raw}') ORDER BY CASE nl.status WHEN 'down' THEN 1 WHEN 'degraded' THEN 2 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,nl.utilization_pct DESC

SELECT now()-interval '5 minutes' AS time, s.name||' · '||nc.redundancy_role AS metric, nc.utilization_pct::double precision AS value FROM inventory.network_circuits nc JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=nc.site_id WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR s.site_key='${site:raw}') ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT site_name AS "Data Center",hostname AS "Device",initcap(replace(device_type,'_',' ')) AS "Type",role AS "Role",manufacturer AS "Vendor",model AS "Model",operating_system||' '||operating_system_version AS "Network OS",management_address AS "Management IP",rack_name AS "Rack",initcap(status) AS "Status",ha_role AS "HA Role",interface_count AS "Interfaces",link_count AS "Links",cpu_utilization_pct AS "CPU %",memory_utilization_pct AS "Memory %",firmware_compliance AS "Firmware",config_backup AS "Config Backup",open_alerts AS "Alerts",last_seen_at AS "Last Seen" FROM inventory.network_device_operational_overview WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR site_key='${site:raw}') AND ('${device_type:raw}'='All' OR device_type='${device_type:raw}') ORDER BY open_alerts DESC,site_name,hostname

SELECT s.name AS "Data Center",nc.provider AS "Carrier",upper(nc.service_type) AS "Service",nc.provider_circuit_id AS "Circuit ID",initcap(nc.redundancy_role) AS "Role",round(nc.bandwidth_bps/1000000000.0,0)||' Gbps' AS "Capacity",nc.utilization_pct AS "Utilization %",nc.latency_ms AS "Latency ms",nc.packet_loss_pct AS "Loss %",nc.availability_pct AS "Availability %",initcap(nc.status) AS "Status" FROM inventory.network_circuits nc JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=nc.site_id WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR s.site_key='${site:raw}') ORDER BY CASE nc.status WHEN 'down' THEN 1 WHEN 'degraded' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,s.name,nc.redundancy_role

SELECT s.name AS "Data Center",nv.name AS "VRF",nv.route_distinguisher AS "Route Distinguisher",nv.route_count AS "Routes",nv.bgp_neighbors_up||' / '||nv.bgp_neighbor_count AS "BGP Neighbors Up",initcap(nv.status) AS "Status",nv.last_converged_at AS "Last Converged" FROM inventory.network_vrfs nv JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=nv.site_id WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR s.site_key='${site:raw}') ORDER BY CASE nv.status WHEN 'down' THEN 1 WHEN 'degraded' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,s.name,nv.name

SELECT s.name AS "Data Center",nv.vlan_id AS "VLAN",nv.name AS "Segment",initcap(nv.purpose) AS "Purpose",nv.vrf_name AS "VRF",nv.cidr AS "Subnet",nv.gateway AS "Gateway",nv.allocated_addresses||' / '||nv.capacity_addresses AS "IP Allocation",round(100.0*nv.allocated_addresses/nullif(nv.capacity_addresses,0),1) AS "IP Utilization %",initcap(nv.status) AS "Status" FROM inventory.network_vlans nv JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=nv.site_id WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR s.site_key='${site:raw}') ORDER BY s.name,nv.vlan_id

SELECT manufacturer||' · '||model AS "Platform",count(*) AS "Devices" FROM inventory.network_device_operational_overview WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR site_key='${site:raw}') AND ('${device_type:raw}'='All' OR device_type='${device_type:raw}') GROUP BY manufacturer,model ORDER BY count(*) DESC

SELECT nd.site_name AS "Data Center",nd.hostname AS "Device",initcap(replace(nd.device_type,'_',' ')) AS "Device Type",ni.interface_name AS "Interface",upper(coalesce(ni.interface_type,'unknown')) AS "Interface Type",CASE WHEN cardinality(ni.ip_addresses)=0 THEN 'Layer 2 — no IP assigned' ELSE array_to_string(ni.ip_addresses,', ') END AS "IP Addresses",CASE WHEN cardinality(ni.ip_addresses)=0 THEN 'L2 switching' ELSE 'L3 routed' END AS "Network Layer",round(ni.speed_bps/1000000000.0,0)||' Gbps' AS "Speed",ni.mtu AS "MTU",initcap(ni.administrative_status) AS "Admin Status",initcap(coalesce(ni.attributes->>'operational_status','unknown')) AS "Operational Status",round(coalesce((ni.attributes->>'rx_utilization_pct')::numeric,0),1) AS "RX Utilization %",round(coalesce((ni.attributes->>'tx_utilization_pct')::numeric,0),1) AS "TX Utilization %",coalesce((ni.attributes->>'errors')::integer,0) AS "Errors",ni.attributes->>'description' AS "Description" FROM inventory.network_interfaces ni JOIN inventory.network_devices d ON d.id=ni.network_device_id JOIN inventory.network_device_operational_overview nd ON nd.device_key=d.device_key WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR nd.site_key='${site:raw}') AND ('${device_type:raw}'='All' OR nd.device_type='${device_type:raw}') ORDER BY CASE coalesce(ni.attributes->>'operational_status','unknown') WHEN 'down' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,coalesce((ni.attributes->>'errors')::integer,0) DESC,nd.site_name,nd.hostname,ni.interface_name

SELECT site_name AS "Data Center",router AS "WAN Router",firewall AS "Firewall",l3_switch AS "L3 Switch",vlan_id AS "VLAN",vrf_name AS "VRF",cidr AS "Subnet",server_name AS "Physical Server",coalesce(vm_name,'—') AS "Virtual Machine",cluster_key AS "Kubernetes Cluster",k8s_node AS "Kubernetes Node",pod_name AS "Pod",initcap(pod_phase) AS "Pod State",application_name AS "Application",business_service AS "Business Service",initcap(replace(path_status,'_',' ')) AS "Path Health" FROM inventory.end_to_end_connectivity_paths WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR site_key='${site:raw}') ORDER BY CASE path_status WHEN 'at_risk' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,site_name,business_service,application_name,pod_name

SELECT site_name AS "Data Center",initcap(replace(source_type,'_',' ')) AS "Source Type",source_key AS "Source Asset",initcap(replace(relationship_type,'_',' ')) AS "Connectivity",initcap(replace(target_type,'_',' ')) AS "Target Type",target_key AS "Target Asset",initcap(status) AS "Health",coalesce(redundancy_group,'—') AS "Redundancy Group",last_seen_at AS "Last Verified" FROM inventory.topology_relationship_overview WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR site_key='${site:raw}') ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'down' THEN 1 WHEN 'degraded' THEN 2 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,site_name,source_type,source_key

SELECT site_name AS "Data Center",server_name AS "Server",rack_name AS "Rack",server_interface AS "Server NIC",coalesce(mac_address::text,'Simulated / not reported') AS "Server MAC",server_ip_addresses AS "Server IP",switch_name AS "Access Switch",switch_interface AS "Switch Port",switch_vendor AS "Switch Vendor",switch_model AS "Switch Model",vlan_id AS "VLAN",vlan_name AS "VLAN Name",vrf_name AS "VRF",cidr AS "Subnet",gateway AS "Gateway",upstream_core_01 AS "Core Switch A",upstream_core_02 AS "Core Switch B",upstream_firewall AS "Firewall",upstream_router AS "WAN Router",initcap(connection_status) AS "Link Status",last_seen_at AS "Last Verified" FROM inventory.server_network_attachment_overview WHERE ('${site:raw}'='All' OR site_key='${site:raw}') ORDER BY CASE connection_status WHEN 'down' THEN 1 WHEN 'degraded' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,site_name,switch_name,server_name

panels.title: Server NIC → Access Switch Port → Upstream Network Mapping

options.content: ℹ️ **Customer demo:** All network inventory, connectivity and telemetry shown here is simulated. Use **Server Port Mapping** to identify the exact server NIC, access-switch port, VLAN and upstream network path. End-to-end topology continues through VM/Kubernetes node → pod → application → business service.
